description: Domain SaaS footprint — Which SaaS tools a company uses, from public DNS only: email provider (MX), email security gateways, sending services (SPF includes, DKIM selectors), DMARC report vendors, verification TXT records (Google, Microsoft 365, Atlassian, Slack, Zoom, Stripe, OpenAI, Anthropic, 1Password, Okta and ~80 more), DNS host (NS) and what common subdomains point to (help desk, docs, status page, shop, careers, website builder, CDN). Grouped by category with the DNS evidence for each, plus SPF/DMARC/BIMI/MTA-STS posture. For sales prospecting, vendor due diligence and attack-surface mapping. Param: domain. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
